# Country scope. The country whose weekly and monthly pulse drives the Community clock (the first to pulse; the next one if it vanishes).
COLDWAR_EC_is_clock = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { global.cwec_clock = THIS.id }
		check_variable = { global.cwec_clock = 0 }
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.cwec_clock > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_clock = { exists = yes } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Full member of the Communities.
COLDWAR_EC_is_member = {
	check_variable = { cwec_status = 5 }
}

# Country scope. Accession treaty signed.
COLDWAR_EC_is_acceding = {
	check_variable = { cwec_status = 4 }
}

# Country scope. Accession negotiations open.
COLDWAR_EC_is_candidate = {
	check_variable = { cwec_status = 3 }
}

# Country scope. Has applied (applicant, candidate or acceding).
COLDWAR_EC_is_applicant = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { cwec_status = 2 }
		check_variable = { cwec_status = 3 }
		check_variable = { cwec_status = 4 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Association agreement (Art. 238).
COLDWAR_EC_is_associate = {
	check_variable = { cwec_status = 1 }
}

# Country scope. A member governed by a player right now (a seated delegation).
COLDWAR_EC_player_member = {
	is_ai = no
	check_variable = { cwec_status = 5 }
}

# Country scope. Governed by a player now or in the last 365 days (absent player).
COLDWAR_EC_seen_player = {
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen
	}
}

# Country scope. Birkelbach clause 1962: free elections, no authoritarian or communist government (MD triggers of check_breach_of_EU_value).
COLDWAR_EC_democratic_clause = {
	has_elections = yes
	NOT = { has_communist_government = yes }
	NOT = { has_reactionary_government = yes }
	NOT = { has_idea = dictatorship }
	NOT = { has_idea = communist_dictatorship }
	NOT = { has_idea = fascist_dictatorship }
}

# Country scope. May apply under Art. 237.
COLDWAR_EC_european = {
	OR = {
		is_in_europe = yes
		original_tag = TUR
		original_tag = CYP
		original_tag = MLT
	}
}

# Country scope. Conditions for an application (players only; the AI never applies).
COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = {
	has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_initialized
	exists = yes
	is_subject = no
	COLDWAR_EC_european = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_democratic_clause = yes
	NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes }
	NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_applicant = yes }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_rejoin_cooldown }
	NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes }
	NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
	NOT = { any_of_scopes = { array = global.cwec_members has_war_with = PREV } }
}

		check_variable = { cwec_ui_sel = 48 }

		AND = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_sel = 62 } check_variable = { cwec_ui_target > 0 } var:cwec_ui_target = { exists = yes check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_target_busy = yes } } }

		check_variable = { cwec_ui_sel = 87 }
		check_variable = { cwec_ui_sel = 88 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Already the subject of an open file.
COLDWAR_EC_target_busy = {
	OR = { AND = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_target = THIS.id } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_target = THIS.id } } }
}
